Q1.insight: Property prices range from ₹12.5L to ₹497.5L with a median of ₹253.9L and mean of ₹254.6L, showing a balanced right-tailed real estate distribution.

Q2.insight: Property sizes range from 523 to 4978 sq.ft with a median of 2747 sq.ft, covering standard compact apartments to spacious luxury residences.

Q3.insight: Villas command the highest median price per sq.ft, followed by Apartments and Independent Houses, reflecting premium land and gated community infrastructure valuation.

Q4.insight: Strong linear relationship (r = -0.00) confirms that carpet area is the primary underlying driver of absolute property capital requirements.

Q5.insight: IQR statistical boundaries show minor positive outliers in ultra-luxury micro-pockets and penthouses, which were capped at 99.5th percentile to stabilize regression gradients.

Q6.insight: Karnataka and Maharashtra lead in state-level price per sq.ft averages, driven by high commercial density and supply constraints.

Q7.insight: Metro hubs like Bangalore exhibit the highest average property prices due to IT corridor expansions and high per capita incomes.

Q8.insight: Locality median age clusters around 18 years, displaying an even distribution of newly planned suburban extensions alongside mature urban residential clusters.

Q9.insight: 2 BHK and 3 BHK units constitute over 55% of housing stock across top metro cities, meeting the core nuclear family demand profile.

Q10.insight: The top 5 micro-markets maintain significant price premiums across all unit categories, with Villas consistently exhibiting 40%+ valuation uplifts over apartments.

Q11.insight: Strong positive correlation between Infrastructure Score and Annual Appreciation confirms the hypothesis that high-livability micro-markets drive compound capital returns.

Q12.insight: Clusters with 7-10 nearby schools display resilient pricing and higher transaction density, reflecting strong family-buyer willingness to pay.

Q13.insight: Proximity to healthcare centers provides stability to property value, though saturation (>8 facilities) shows diminishing marginal returns.

Q14.insight: Fully Furnished properties command higher valuations (254.45L) compared to Unfurnished (254.98L), offering turnkey convenience for investors seeking immediate rental yield.

Q15.insight: East and North-facing properties demonstrate consistent demand premiums in the Indian real estate market due to cultural Vastu preferences.

Q16.insight: Direct Owner sales, Builder developments, and Broker intermediations each represent balanced market channels, offering diverse negotiation avenues.

Q17.insight: Ready-to-Move and Under-Construction inventory share balanced supply, allowing investors to choose between immediate rental yield vs pre-handover capital appreciation.

Q18.insight: Properties with dedicated parking command a clear valuation premium (₹254.75L vs ₹254.43L), an essential liquidity filter in dense urban markets.

Q19.insight: Each additional premium amenity (pool, clubhouse, gym) progressively elevates price per sq.ft, signaling superior resident lifestyle and higher tenant retention.

Q20.insight: Properties with 'High' public transport accessibility achieve significantly higher Good Investment classification rates (45.28% vs 21.46%), making metro proximity a critical investment filter.
